title: Phosphatase assays using ligated phosphoprotein substrates
protocol: Mix the carrier protein and phosphopeptide in a molar ratio of at least 1:25 (CP: peptide).
Conduct the intein-mediated protein ligation reaction at 4°C for 16 hours or at 25°C for 4 hours.
Evaluate the ligation efficiency by observing a shift in mobility of the LPP compared to unligated CP on Coomassie Blue stained SDS-PAGE.
Store excess free peptide by dialysis using a nitrocellulose filter or Slide-a-lyzer.
Remove excess unligated free peptide through dialysis.
Store ligated phosphoprotein products at -20°C for up to one month or at -80°C for at least six months.
Dilute the ligated phosphoprotein \(LPP) substrates in PBS buffer.
Apply the diluted LPP samples to a polystyrene 96-well microtiter plate.
Coat each well with 100 μl of a diluted LPP sample containing 2 μg CP and approximately 1.5 μg peptide or a 13 μM peptide solution (~1.5 μg peptide).
Incubate the plate at 37°C overnight.
Wash each well coated with LPP substrate three times (each with 100 μl PBS).
Add phosphatase and 10X buffer to each well.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 hour or as recommended by the manufacturer.
Mix 5 μl of 10X TC PTP reaction buffer, 0.25 μl of TC PTP (10,000 unit/ml), and 44.75 μl dH2O to prepare the TC PTP reaction mixture.
Mix 5 μl of 10X PP1 reaction buffer, 5 μl of 10X MnCl2, 0.4 μl of PP1 (2,500 unit/ml), and 39 μl dH2O to prepare the PP1 reaction mixture.
Wash each well three times with 100 μl PBST.
Add 100 μl of PBST containing 4% non-fat milk.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 h.
Wash each well with PBST three times.
Add 100 μl of phospho-specific antibody prepared in PBST containing 2% non-fat milk.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 h with mild shaking.
Wash three times with 100 μl PBST.
Incubate with HRP-conjugated secondary antibody prepared in PBST containing 2% non-fat milk at room temperature for 1 h.
After three washes with PBST, add 100 μl of ABTS developing solution.
Measure the colorimetric signal at OD<sub>415</sub>.
